column2: Retain David's cedar house contrasted with the covenant ark beneath skins. Behold is explicit; no separate tent noun is added to the second half.

Retain Nathan's permission to do everything in David's soul and the rationale that God is with him. Ordinary you addresses the king, and the initial advice is not rewritten to anticipate the correction.
Retain that night, the Lord's word coming to Nathan and the introduction of speech. The temporal connection distinguishes this revelation from Nathan's earlier advice.

Retain the command to Nathan and the prohibition directed to David of building the dwelling house. The Greek places emphasis on you; the English keeps the named addressee and does not imply that no one will build it.
Retain the period from bringing Israel up to the present and both tent and lodging. Do not expand the selected brief clause into a sequence of migrations between tents.
Retain one tribe of Israel and the reported failure to build a cedar house, not a harmonized reference to one judge. Ever reflects the rhetorical question, not a separate Greek adverb.
column3: Appointed supplies the inferred relation between the tribe and shepherding; the precise syntactic force and absence of an explicit appointment verb remain open.

column2: Retain Almighty, sheepfold, following the flocks and becoming leader over Israel. Human David receives ordinary you even in divine speech.
Retain past accompaniment, destruction of all enemies and making David's name like those of the great on earth. These are not converted into future promises.
Retain the planted people's dwelling by themselves, freedom from anxiety and injustice no longer humbling them. The selected subject is injustice, not explicitly sons of wickedness.
Retain the judges-period reference, past humbling of all enemies, future increase and the Lord building David a house. The switch from divine first person to the Lord remains visible.
column3: The attachment of from the days to the prior comparison or present clause needs discourse review; no added rest-from-enemies clause resolves it.

column2: Retain fulfilled days, sleep with fathers, offspring from David's body and preparation of his kingdom. Do not substitute one of your sons for the selected bodily expression.
Retain the offspring building God a house and God's setting his throne upright for ever. This reciprocates the house promise without treating the two houses as necessarily the same kind of structure.
Retain Father and son, mercy not withdrawn and plural those before David. No singular Saul is substituted, and no punishment clause from a parallel narrative is added.
Retain My house but his kingdom, both enduring, and the throne being set upright. The second possessive is not harmonized to My kingdom.
Retain all the words and all the vision as the extent of Nathan's report. Vision remains even though the revelation was introduced as a word at night.

Retain David entering and sitting before the Lord, his two questions and Thou hast loved me for ever. Do not replace the selected love expression with brought me thus far. Direct prayer begins the Thou register.

Retain the smallness of these things before God, speech concerning the house far ahead, human vision and exaltation. The difficult selected comparison is not replaced with an interpretation about a man of high degree.
column3: As a human vision is semantically opaque and grammatically unusual; far ahead may express distance of time or scope. These remain unresolved, not approved polished wording.

column2: Retain what more David can add in glorifying and God's knowledge of His servant. Thy and Thee address God, while David remains third person.
Retain the selected short statement about doing all this greatness according to Thy heart. Do not import for Thy servant's sake or making greatness known from another witness.
Retain both none like Thee and none besides Thee, grounded in everything heard with our ears. The plural our includes the broader worshipping people within David's prayer.

Retain God's leading Israel to redeem a people for Himself, a great and manifest name and expulsion of nations before the people redeemed from Egypt. Divine third-person references and direct Thy/Thou both occur in the prayer.
Retain God's giving Israel to Himself as an enduring people and being their God. No established-for-yourself verb is substituted for the selected gave.

Retain the wish that God's word to His servant and concerning the house be made secure for ever. The sentence continues into the people's saying in verse 24 rather than adding an omitted do-as-spoken command.
Retain the repeated Lord, Almighty and God of Israel, with the servant's house set upright before God. People is supplied for the unnamed plural speakers, and let continues the preceding petition.
column3: The attachment of the plural participle and the force of the following nominal house clause need syntactic review; no missing praise sentence is reconstructed.

column2: Retain the opened-ear image and the house-building disclosure. Found courage is an inherited contextual supplement to the incomplete found-to-pray construction, not a separately expressed noun.
column3: Review whether courage, occasion or a less explicit found-it-possible formulation best conveys the selected ellipsis without importing heart from a parallel.

column2: Retain God identified as God and His speaking these good things concerning the servant. The direct divine address consistently retains Thou and Thy.
Retain begun to bless, the purpose of remaining before God, completed blessing and final imperative bless for ever. Do not turn the final command into an assurance that it will remain blessed.

Retain striking and routing the foreigners, and taking Geth with its villages from their hand. The selected place and dependent villages are not replaced with the parallel account's different expression.
Retain Moab struck and becoming David's servants bearing gifts. No measuring-cord execution account is imported into this short unit.
Retain Adraazar, Souba, Hemath and establishing his hand upon the Euphrates. The inherited comma leaves Hemath's relation and the departing subject provisional.
column3: Does Hemath locate the action or qualify the kingdom, and who is going to establish his hand? The selected syntax does not warrant an unqualified resolution here.

column2: Retain one thousand chariots, seven thousand horses and twenty thousand foot soldiers. Disabled chariots and one hundred spared chariots are explicit; no horse hamstringing or alternate figure is substituted.

Retain the collective Syrian coming from Damascus, aid to Adraazar and twenty-two thousand men struck among that force. The English force makes the collective sense readable without creating a second army.
Retain the garrison in Syria near Damascus, tribute service and the Lord's repeated saving in David's journeys. Keep the continuing aspect rather than limiting protection to this battle.
Retain golden collars upon Adraazar's servants and their transfer to Jerusalem. The selected objects are not silently changed to shields.
Retain Metabechas, choice cities, abundant bronze and its later use by Solomon for the sea, pillars and vessels. Choice remains an adjective rather than a supplied second city name.
column3: The inherited Metabechas place form and the interpretation of the selected lowercase expression require onomastic review.

column2: Retain Thoa of Hemath hearing that David struck the whole force of Adraazar of Souba. This is the trigger for the following embassy, not Thoa joining the battle.

Retain Idouram, inquiry about peace, congratulatory blessing and Thoa's hostility toward Adraazar. With him were supplies the elliptical relation of the silver and gold vessels; no bronze vessels are added here.
column3: The final vessel phrase has no expressed bringing verb, and the best treatment of its ellipsis remains open.

column2: Retain consecration to the Lord and the full five-source list: Idumea, Moab, Ammon, foreigners and Amalek. Do not substitute Syria for Idumea or add omitted nations.
Retain Abessa son of Sarouia as the agent, Idumea, the Valley of Salts and eighteen thousand. No parallel attribution to David or Joab replaces this explicit agent.

Retain the valley garrisons and all Idumeans becoming David's servants, followed by the repeated divine-saving formula. The implied he follows Abessa in the selected sequence and is not explicitly replaced with David.
Retain rule over all Israel and ongoing judgment and righteousness for all his people. Both repeated all expressions remain.
Retain Joab over the army and Josaphat son of Achiloud as recorder. The two offices and genealogies are not combined.
Retain Sadok son of Achitob and Achimelech son of Abiathar as priests, and Sousa as secretary. The father-son direction is not reversed to match another roster.
Retain Banaias over Chereththi and Pheleththi and the inherited foremost successors for David's sons. The selected title differs from priests in a parallel narrative.
column3: Diadochoi may denote deputies, those next in rank or successors; foremost successors is provisional and should not be treated as an established claim that all sons inherited the throne.
